thesis: Hold. Sizing book is about $999 equity and $750 cash (75%), with one position: VTI near $249 (~25%), inside the 35% name cap, the 15% cash floor, and the six-name limit. This 13:00 ET pack does not justify adding a name or selling VTI. Yields are still rising (10Y 5.281%, +4.1bp; TLT -0.88%), junk bonds are heading for their worst month since 2022, hiring is weak, and breadth is poor even with the S&P near a record — cash stays the ballast rather than buying duration or more beta. Name items are not actionable: Deutsche Bank on Netflix and the Nvidia valuation note are opinion; TSMC’s second U.S. site is reported, not confirmed; Micron is a preview, not a result; Carnival’s 8-K is Item 2.02 with no figures; Novo’s second licensing deal has no terms and follows a poorly received strategy day; MongoDB’s CEO move is yesterday’s news and the pack already describes a large decline we do not own. Commodity-fund 8-Ks are routine Reg FD. Nothing here is a VTI-specific negative, so the existing large-cap sleeve stays.
